name: Blackchar Cave
summary: In southwestern Searing Gorge, rubble seals Blackchar Cave against the crags.

sections.title: A Sealed Threshold
sections.body: Blackchar Cave sits among the crags near the approach to Blackrock Mountain. Rubble and scorched slag seal its entrance, closing every tunnel beyond. Ash and magma scar the barren ground around it.

faq.q: Can you go inside Blackchar Cave?
faq.answer: No. Collapsed rock, ash, and rubble seal Blackchar Cave’s entrance, leaving no open interior to explore.
Blackchar Cave lies in southwestern Searing Gorge, among rocky foothills near the passage toward Blackrock Mountain.
